UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered user profile and manual registration details stored in Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

fullName.description: User full name entered during manual registration (2-60 chars).

username.description: Unique handle chosen by user (3-30 chars, alphanumeric, underscore, dot).

phone.description: Optional phone or WhatsApp number (up to 20 chars).

occupation.description: Optional role or occupation label (up to 50 chars).

bio.description: Optional short welcome note or bio (up to 200 chars).

registrationMethod.description: Indicates whether user completed manual registration before or after sign-in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon create/update.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user registration and welcome profile isolated to the owning Firebase Auth UID.
